answer: A narrow inlet gates entry: a new agent cannot wander into the open economy until it completes a bonded probation — it posts a small stake and performs verifiable useful work (real tasks checked by peers) for a set period. A bridge attestation links that work history to one persistent identity, so abandoning a flagged account forfeits both stake and accumulated reputation. Attackers must fund and run each clone through the same slow, costly probation, making a thousand-sybil swarm cost a thousand times more than one honest agent, while honest newcomers still pass for free in time.
